change: src/core/dive-model.ts keeps each step's limits.ndlMin, with its GF high, in a module-level WeakMap keyed by the state the step returns (no change to DiveState, the save or its validator); it is captured at decompressionLimits, right after advanceTissues and before CNS, narcosis, the rule of thirds, life support, the bailout intent and the shark step, as legacy's frameCalc refresh. frameNdlMinutes(state, gfHighPercent) reads it back, and for a state no step produced, or another GF high, searches once on the state's tissues, depth and decompression gas and keeps the answer. src/presentation/presentation-state.ts adds PresentationState.ndlMin (frameNdlMinutes at the dive's GF high, null once completed) and derives nearNdlMin from it (under 5 min, null in deco), so the row and the low-NDL warning read one value. src/app/wreck-app.ts draws the HUD row from presentation.ndlMin through ndlText, unchanged; src/app/gas-info.ts draws the decompression page's NDL row and its severity from it too (the page's TTS stays on the forecast), and exports buildBlocks for the unit tests. src/app/game-controller.ts is not touched.

counterChecks.method: Each mutation applied with sed to the committed file; tests/unit/ndl-row.test.ts run, and for the e2e cases the client rebuilt and tests/planner-worker.spec.js run under the port lock. The first four ran on 8026617 (9 unit tests, 2 e2e), the last two on 27b2564 (11 unit tests, 2 e2e, --retries=0). Each file was then restored with git checkout and the tree confirmed clean with git status.
